messages:
Jordan (CS): Heads-up — Tessera Labs renewal landed in mailbox. They want a faster Dedicated onboarding + KMS for private keys, which bumps the price. Renewal date 2026-05-12.
Aisha (AE): Thanks — estimate from pricing: +18% yr1 for Dedicated + KMS onboarding fee (one-time). I floated a compromise: keep current net license rate, add a one-time infra onboarding fee.
Jordan (CS): Procurement pinged: they need PO and prefer Net45. Finance prefers CC or Net30 for new add-ons.
Finance-bot: Internal note: new customers or seat uplifts default to Net30; exceptions require sales ops + finance signoff.
Aisha (AE): @Marco we need legal to confirm whether we can keep the existing SOW and append an addendum for KMS + Dedicated, or we need a fresh SOW. Procurement will only sign with vendor company name visible on SOW.
Marco (Legal): Quick read: addendum fine for scope change as long as we reference original SOW id. Need to add export-control clause for the private deployment. I can draft; will need client signature on addendum.
Priya (Onboarding): Timeline check — Dedicated provisioning + KMS key exchange needs ~10 business days after signed order and KMS credentials. If we get signoff by 2026-04-28, we can hit their desired window.
Aisha (AE): Sending them two options now: (A) One-time onboarding fee + Net30 CC flow (faster) or (B) Keep Net45 with PO but onboarding delayed by 2 weeks.
Jordan (CS): Can we do a short note for procurement that lists deliverables / dates? They asked for milestones in the PO.
Priya (Onboarding): Draft milestones: 1) Order confirmed & PO received / creds provided, 2) Dedicated cluster provisioned, 3) KMS key rotation & verification, 4) Enablement session + handoff. Each with estimated days from order. I’ll paste text when ready.
Aisha (AE): I just replied to procurement with both options and asked which they prefer, pushed for Net30 if possible. Included link to proposed addendum draft: https://redwood.example/sow/addendum/tessera-dedicated-kms (preview link).
Marco (Legal): I added the export-control paragraph and changed the signature block to include vendor legal name and EIN.
DocuSign Bot: DocuSign envelope created (env_0x9c): https://docusign.example/envelope/env_0x9c — contains addendum + PO acceptance.
Jordan (CS): Procurement responded — they prefer PO (Net45) but asked to remove the onboarding fee and roll it into MRR. That would change the contract math; Aisha can you confirm numbers?
Aisha (AE): If we roll the fee into MRR, revenue recognition shifts; it reduces upfront cash. I propose a 6-month amortization added to monthly billing to keep cash hit lower. Need finance approval.
Finance-bot: Proposal logged: amortize onboarding fee over 6 months; approval needed from RevOps.
Marco (Legal): Rolling fees into MRR is fine contractually; update addendum to show fee schedule and amortization approach. Ensure invoicing language matches billing entity requirements.
Jordan (CS): One blocker — signer on procurement side is an authorized manager but not the legal signee. Procurement asked if we can accept a delegated signature; legal wants a letter of delegation.
Aisha (AE): I asked procurement to upload delegation letter to the DocuSign envelope. They said they can, but might take 48 hours.
Priya (Onboarding): Plan assuming docs complete by 2026-04-30. If delegation delays past that, provisioning slips by one week.
Jordan (CS): Ok, action list: Aisha — confirm amortization + update addendum; Marco — update addendum with delegation acceptance clause; Priya — block provisioning slot; I’ll keep procurement nudged.
Aisha (AE): On it. Will update envelope by EOD.
Marco (Legal): Draft updated and uploaded.
DocuSign Bot: Envelope updated (env_0x9c) — delegation letter field added.
Jordan (CS): Thanks team. I’ll follow up tomorrow with procurement. :thumbsup:
Aisha (AE): FYI — procurement asked for a billing contact in EU entity field. Sending to finance to confirm billing entity mapping.
Finance-bot: Confirmed billing entity: Redwood Inference, EU Subsidiary (EU-01).
Jordan (CS): Great — closing loop. Will post final once signed.
